name: reach
title: Reaching for the archive unprompted
command: eval/skill_eval.py run --set holdout --ask plain --cond C [--skill OLD.md]

conditions.questions: 23 held out, asked plainly with no hint that they are about past work
conditions.source: the author's own session archive; only counts leave it

summary: Whether rewording the skill's trigger description around agent situations ("before asking the user", "after a compaction") makes agents search more often. It did not, so the wording was left alone.
bar: at least 15 points more questions searched
baseline: the same skill with its existing trigger wording
meaning: Rewording the triggers made no real difference (one question in 23), so the wording was not changed. Fresh agents already search about four times in five without being told.
